futureYearNotice: You’re viewing the upcoming 2028–29 calendar. Canyons School District has tentatively approved this calendar, so dates may change before the school year begins. Last reviewed August 10, 2026, using the district’s November 12, 2025 K–12 and Brighton calendars.
heroSourceLine: Source: Canyons School District 2028–29 K-12 calendar · Revised November 12, 2025
heroSummary: Canyons students in grades 1–12 begin Monday, August 14, 2028, following half-day orientation for sixth- and ninth-graders on August 11. Kindergarten begins August 16. Graduation is May 23, and the last day of school is May 24, 2029. Every instructional Friday is an early-out day, while Brighton High School follows a separate trimester calendar.
calendarNotes: Canyons schedules teachers back August 7–11 and half-day sixth- and ninth-grade orientation August 11 before grades 1–12 begin August 14. Kindergarten begins August 16. The K-12 calendar marks every instructional Friday as early out and prints red A-day and black B-day labels for secondary rotation. September conferences differ by school level and lead into a September 21 early-out day, September 22 compensatory day, and September 25 professional day. Fall Recess is October 26–27, Winter Recess is December 20–January 2, and Spring Break is April 2–6. Brighton shares the August 14 opening and May 24 ending but uses trimester endings November 9 and February 15 plus separate conference, grading, and no-student dates. The official PDF labels January 22 as Martin Luther King Jr. Day Recess; this page preserves the printed school-closure date and flags the label for district confirmation.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2027–28
content: Grades 1–12 begin August 14 and kindergarten August 16, two days earlier than in 2027–28.
Fall Recess shifts from October 21–22 to October 26–27, after an October 20 professional day.
Winter Recess extends through January 2 instead of ending December 31.
Graduation and the final day move one day earlier to May 23 and May 24.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Canyons School District start in 2028–29?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 begin Monday, August 14, 2028. Sixth- and ninth-graders have half-day orientation on August 11, and kindergarten begins August 16.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Canyons Spring Break in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break Recess runs Monday, April 2 through Friday, April 6, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Brighton use the K-12 quarter calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Brighton uses a separate trimester calendar with different grading, conference, professional, and compensatory dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Is every Friday an early-out day in Canyons?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Both the K–12 and Brighton calendars say every instructional Friday is an early-out day; the exact dismissal time is school-specific.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does this page list January 22 as Martin Luther King Jr. Day Recess?
calendarFaqs.a: Both official CSD PDFs print January 22 as the no-school date under that label and show January 15 as instructional. This page preserves the district's printed attendance date and flags the label for confirmation if CSD republishes the calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: How are emergency closures made up?
calendarFaqs.a: CSD says emergency closure days will be recovered through scheduled remote-learning days rather than a fixed date printed in advance.

sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed the staggered orientation and openings, level-specific conferences, Friday early-out rule, A/B legend, breaks, staff days, three district-listed quarter endings, graduation, and May 24 last day from the K-12 PDF.
Reviewed the Brighton PDF separately because its trimester endings, conference dates, grading days, and several professional or compensatory days differ from the district K–12 calendar.

Both PDFs label January 22, 2029, as Martin Luther King Jr. Day Recess while showing January 15 as instructional. This page preserves the printed no-school date, adds visible qualification, and sets a correction review trigger.
Both PDFs say emergency closures will be made up through scheduled remote-learning days and do not assign a fixed makeup date in advance.
We did not find a separate translated 2028–29 calendar in the district resources reviewed.

The one-time ICS file excludes recurring Friday early-out reminders, daily A/B markers, level-specific conferences, quarter endings, graduation, Brighton-only dates, later calendar revisions, and emergency-closure updates.
